def: to buy up, i.e. ransom; figuratively, to rescue from loss (improve opportunity)

occurrences.text: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
